_about: SAN-883 · DEV-SEC — SHA-256 hashes of browser-PUBLISHABLE Google Maps API keys (NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY / VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY). These keys ship in client bundles by design and are gated by HTTP-referrer restrictions in Google Cloud Console, so recognising them is safe. HASHES ONLY — no raw key is committed (so GitHub push-protection and human reviewers never see a key-shaped string). The dist-leak-scan hook allows an AIzaSy… match ONLY when its value hashes to one of these; every other Google key (Gemini, arbitrary GOOGLE_*), Supabase service-role, Stripe, etc. still BLOCKS the deploy command.
_rotation: When the publishable Maps key rotates, append the new value's SHA-256 here (compute: printf '%s' "$KEY" | sha256sum). Old hashes may be left or pruned; leaving them only allows already-public keys.
